run_png2ico_cli: run the png2ico script to convert multiple PNG files into a single ICO file
convert_pngs_to_ico: convert PNG files with width and height in filenames into an ICO file
parse_filename_dimensions: parse width and height from PNG filenames using a regex pattern like 16x16
write_ico_header: write an ICO file header with struct packing that specifies the number of images
write_ico_directory_entry: write an ICO directory entry for each PNG with dimensions, size, and offset data
